description:
My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this well-presented two bedroom second floor apartment, ideally located close to Newcastle University, the Dental School and Medical School.

The property comprises two similarly sized double bedrooms, a modern bathroom with shower over bath, and neutral, contemporary décor throughout. The apartment also benefits from allocated parking. Ideally situated within walking distance of Newcastle city centre, the property is also well served by excellent bus transport links, providing easy access to the surrounding areas.

To arrange a viewing, please call My Property Box on 0191 212 0400 and speak to our Lettings Team today.
